invariant_bindings.invariant_text: A DomainEvent MUST be immutable after construction; mutation or retroactive edit of event_id, aggregate_id, occurred_at, version, or payload is FORBIDDEN.
event_id MUST be a globally unique UUID v7 so idempotent consumers CAN dedupe reliably and no two distinct facts SHALL share the same identifier.
The event type NEVER carries commands or intents; event_type MUST record a past-tense fact, imperative verbs are FORBIDDEN as the terminal segment.
version SHALL increment strictly by one per aggregate stream and serves as the ordering key; gaps, retroactive inserts, and duplicate versions are FORBIDDEN.
Schema evolution within an event_type MUST be additive; schema_version bumps CANNOT remove or rename fields, a new event_type is required instead.
